question: Who was the chairman of ISRO when Chandrayaan-1 was launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**G Madhavan Nair**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **G. Madhavan Nair **is an **Indian space scientist **and a **former Chairman **of the **Indian Space Research Organisation**.
 
• He was the **Secretary to the Department of Space**, Government of India.
 
• He has **also been the Chairman of the Space Commission **and **Chairman of the Governing Body of the Antrix Corporation**, Bangalore.
 
• He was **born on 31 October 1943 **in **Kulasekharam**.
 
• **G Madhavan Nair **was the **chairman of ISRO whebn Chandrayaan-1 was launched**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam **was an **Indian aerospace scientist **and **statesman **who served as the **11th President of India **from **2002 to 2007**.
 
• **Mr. Umamaheswaran R**. is currently **Distinguished Scientist **and **Scientific Secretary**, **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), Department of Space (DOS), **Government of India.
 
• **Chandrayaan-1 **was the **first Indian lunar probe **under the **Chandrayaan program**.
 
• It was **launched **by the **Indian Space Research Organisation **in **October 2008**, and **operated until August 2009**.
 
• The **mission included **a **lunar orbiter **and **an impactor**
